tags: @pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason='SECURITY GAP: bulk-delete calls supabaseAdmin with no isAdminRequest() guard, so an unauthenticated caller can delete items. When the guard is added this xfail flips to xpass — remove the marker and assert 403.')

tags: @pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason='SECURITY GAP: PUT /api/ratings has no isAdminRequest() guard, so any anonymous caller can upsert/overwrite scores.
